title: Sith Probe Droid
caption: Sith Probe Droid (V)
game_text: _When drawn for destiny during a battle or duel involving a Dark Jedi, destiny +2._ During your move phase, may use 2 Force to relocate a Dark Jedi (with any captives they are escorting) to same site; place this droid in Used Pile.
lore: Patrol droids utilized by the Sith. Each droid has several multispectral imaging devices and a communications package. Used by Maul to track down Amidala.
copyright: © 2001 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2001 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Group: Everything else. Not unique. Bottom-half slip. Stat row POWER 1 / MANEUVER 3 / RECON DROID (label only, as printed); deploy 1 / forfeit 2; NO icon column (only the VS15 sphere; the printed card has none either). The first sentence is set in italics on the slip → _…_. Credits below the text box: 'Original concept by Lee Clarke' left, 'ACT Championship 2005' right. Droid (Episode I droid disc on the printed card). Ring icons on the printed card: Tatooine + Episode I. Stats/deploy/forfeit unchanged from the printed card; text replaced. Lore matches the scan; copyright 2001 read on the scan. 350 px scan only. Modern: VB5-D-sithprobedroid-pre.gif (same text). Art: printed scan by its measured Episode I window (art.rect; the old trim zoomed in — Bill 2026-10-14).
